subject: Bootstrapped p-values for parameters with missing data

messages.author: a8b75c738a120994
messages.subject: Bootstrapped p-values for parameters with missing data
parts:
Dear all,

I am trying to run a serial mediation model in lavaan with data that is both incomplete and non-normal. Therefore, I would like to use missing = "ML" and test = "bootstrap" but the second gives me a lavaan ERROR that bootstrap is not available for missing data.

I have found semTools::bsBootMiss, but that does not seem to be able to provide information about individual parameters. Is there any other way to get bootstrapped p-values, especially for defined parameters (indirect paths)? Or at least bootstrapped confidence intervals?

If that's not possible, what would be the best way to proceed? Bootstrap SEs and hope that they are approximately normal with a high number of bootstraps? I am struggling to get my head around this fully, so I would be grateful for any guidance.

Many thanks, all the best,

Lukas
